links.outcome: Cross-institution generalization of SDoH extraction models trained on one dataset and tested on others
links.effect: Models performed well when trained and tested on individual datasets (LLM micro-F1 over 0.9 on level 1 corpora, over 0.84 on level 2), but cross-dataset generalization highlighted remaining obstacles.
links.quote: While models performed well when trained and tested on individual datasets, cross-dataset generalization highlighted remaining obstacles.

unlisted_practices: Merging annotated datasets from multiple institutions to train a more generalizable SDoH extraction model

screen.reason: The study evaluates the generalizability of LLMs (LLaMA) and traditional NLP methods for extracting social determinants of health across clinical notes from four institutions, assessing performance via automated benchmark metrics.
